lede: Auburn carries the stronger underlying team rating — +2.6 against +0.3, a 2.3-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Auburn -4.2 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Auburn winning 61% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is offense, where Florida leads Auburn by 74 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 41% — enough to publish, not enough to treat the exact margin as settled.
